solved_condition: A query counts as solved only when Sundance answers `unsat` **and emits an eDRAT proof that the checker (`edrat-check/`) accepts**. An `unsat` without an accepted proof does not count. See a proof with `edrat-check/edrat_check.py QUERY PROOF -v`.
metric: gap to Z3 in percentage points on the Verus dev split (splits/verus-dev.txt, 259 queries; lower is better; 0 = as good as Z3)

anchors.zero: the unmodified solver at solver_base_commit (the starting point)
anchors.one: Z3 with the verifier's options (the reference; its internals are not provided)

baseline.holdout_note: holdout split (2,317 Verus queries): 82.6% solved, Z3 99.8%; measured 2026-11-24 by agent.grade
